subject: Help! points labels in scatter plot with facets (using ggplot2)

messages.author: 3611077dfa30daca
messages.subject: Help! points labels in scatter plot with facets (using ggplot2)
parts:
אודה מאד לעזרתכם, לאחר שלא הצלחתי למצוא תשובה. 

אני מעוניין לעשות תרשים פיזור (scatter plot) בחלוקה לfacets, כאשר בכל אחד מהfacets ליד הנקודות יוצגו labels של הנקודות. 

משום מה זה עובד לי בלי הfacets או בלי הlabels אבל לא עובד כאשר אני מבקש את שניהם. 

הרצתי משהו כזה:
ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = x, y = y))+
  geom_point()+
  stat_smooth(method="lm")+
  geom_text(aes(label=mylabels))+
  facet_wrap(~myfacets)

הוא רשם לי את ההערה הבאה:
Error in unit(x, default.units) : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0



לעזרתכם אודה, 

ושנה טובה (:

סער

parts:
that error usually comes up when the class of the variables has a mismatch. 

can you paste to the mail the summary(df) or glimpse(df). you can also attach the first 50 or so rows of the data (as csv or rdata) so we can help you better.

yoni

messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] Re: Help! points labels in scatter plot with facets (using ggplot2)
parts:
the problem seems to be with the facet_wrap, as some of the facets have no data in it. without the last facet_wrap, the graph seems to be fine. if you drop all the NAs in the TENURE variable, everything works just fine. the "NA" facet has no points in it. it is fine with the geom_point (it just plots nothing), but when it come to text...well...there is some text there and it doesn't know where to plot it)

hth
amit
